text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific antidote for overdosage with ENTEREG. Patients should be managed with appropriate supportive therapy. Single doses up to 120 mg and multiple doses up to 48 mg for 7 days have been administered to normal, healthy subjects in clinical studies. In these studies, alvimopan was well tolerated with no discontinuations due to adverse events and no reported serious adverse events or deaths.
